_comment: NpcRepProfile. Faction sets the base lens (which itself deviates from the region baseline); Personal_Weights override/extend it so individuals deviate further. Party COMPANIONS are intentionally excluded (Klee, Yae Miko, Paimon) UNLESS campaign events give them a standing of their own that the party is judged against - Ayaka (deceased, Day 20) and Dehya/'Dea' (desert ally) are listed for that reason. Status 'deceased'/'special' kept for history. Gods are filed under the faction that best represents their domain/worship.

npcs.Name: Jean
npcs.Notes: Acting Grand Master.

npcs.Name: Amber
npcs.Notes: Outrider; optimistic, baffled by Brian C.

npcs.Name: Kaeya
npcs.Notes: Cavalry Captain; suave and shrewd.

npcs.Name: Diluc
npcs.Notes: Acts independently; fights the Abyss and despises the Fatui.

npcs.Name: Venti
npcs.Notes: Barbatos, Anemo Archon, incognito as a bard among the people. Weakened after the Fatui took Venti's gnosis.

npcs.Name: Albedo
npcs.Notes: Chief Alchemist; an artificial human made by Gold.

npcs.Name: Bennett
npcs.Notes: Brave, kind, catastrophically unlucky.

npcs.Name: Eula
npcs.Notes: Reconnaissance Company; proud, vindictive streak but honorable.

npcs.Name: Katherine
npcs.Notes: Guild receptionist (one of many).

npcs.Name: Mona
npcs.Notes: Astrologer; prideful, broke, refuses to profit from astrology. The party gave Mona coins, then bruised Mona over a 2-gold valuation.

npcs.Name: Razor
npcs.Notes: Feral orphan raised by wolves; claymore + electro.

npcs.Name: Childe
npcs.Notes: Tartaglia, 11th Harbinger. Befriended the party through battle; loves a worthy fight.

npcs.Name: Zhongli
npcs.Notes: Morax, the retired Geo Archon. Contracts are sacred to Zhongli above all.

npcs.Name: Hu Tao
npcs.Notes: 77th Director; playful poet who honors the dead.

npcs.Name: Ningguang
npcs.Notes: Tianquan ('Ning Wong'); shrewd, pragmatic, will scapegoat for stability. Cheated the party on rewards.

npcs.Name: Ganyu
npcs.Notes: Qixing secretary with Adeptal blood; diligent to a fault.

npcs.Name: Keqing
npcs.Notes: Yuheng; believes in human effort over reliance on gods.

npcs.Name: Yaoyao
npcs.Notes: Adeptal disciple; gentle and caring.

npcs.Name: Cloud Retainer
npcs.Notes: Adeptus; proud, brilliant, quick to vengeance over slights to Liyue.

npcs.Name: Beidou
npcs.Notes: Captain of the Crux; fearless smuggler who got the party into Inazuma.

npcs.Name: Kazuha
npcs.Notes: Wandering ronin and first mate; calm and principled.

npcs.Name: Thoma
npcs.Notes: Kamisato housekeeper/fixer; the party saved Thoma from the Vision Hunt Decree.

npcs.Name: Kamisato Ayato
npcs.Notes: Clan head; shrewd political operator.

npcs.Name: Kujou Sara
npcs.Notes: Honor-bound general; will respect a worthy enemy even while opposing them.

npcs.Name: Hiiragi Shinzuki
npcs.Notes: Clan head; grumpy hardass who threw Brian F. out for snark.

npcs.Name: Hiiragi Chisato
npcs.Notes: Shinzuki's confined daughter; resents Shinzuki, sweet on Kujou Kamaji.

npcs.Name: Sangonomiya Kokomi
npcs.Notes: High Priestess and resistance strategist; thought the party reckless for challenging the Raiden.

npcs.Name: Gorou
npcs.Notes: Loyal resistance general.

npcs.Name: Raiden Shogun
npcs.Notes: Ei / Beelzebub, Electro Archon. After the party stood up to the Raiden, the Raiden paused the Vision Hunt and won't brand the party traitors. Respects courage and resolve.

npcs.Name: Scaramouche
npcs.Notes: The Balladeer, 6th Harbinger; a discarded puppet of the Raiden. Contemptuous of all 'lesser' beings.

npcs.Name: La Signora
npcs.Notes: 8th Harbinger; disintegrated by the Raiden after losing a death-duel to the party.

npcs.Name: Tighnari
npcs.Notes: Sardonic forest ranger; mentor to Collei.

npcs.Name: Collei
npcs.Notes: Ranger trainee; survivor of Dottore's 'questionable' alazar treatments.

npcs.Name: Nahida
npcs.Notes: Lesser Lord Kusanali, the Dendro Archon and god of wisdom; child-like, deeply kind and perceptive. Helped the party break the Sumeru dream loop.

npcs.Name: Alhaitham
npcs.Notes: Scribe; aloof and pragmatic, does the minimum the bureaucracy demands and no more.

npcs.Name: Dunyarzad
npcs.Notes: Sickly, kind-hearted aristocrat and devotee of Kusanali; the dream loop centered on saving Dunyarzad.

npcs.Name: Nilou
npcs.Notes: Dancer of the Sabzeruz festival.

npcs.Name: Azar
npcs.Notes: Grand Sage; dismissive tyrant of knowledge who scorns the arts and orchestrated the dream-harvesting.

npcs.Name: Hypasia
npcs.Notes: Scholar who meditated three years to connect with Irminsul.

npcs.Name: Veehar
npcs.Notes: Festival emissary of the God of Flowers (candy stall).

npcs.Name: Dainsleif
npcs.Notes: Cursed former knight-captain of Khaenri'ah; opposes the Abyss and disagreed with the spouses' extreme methods. Ally of convenience.

npcs.Name: Halfdan
npcs.Notes: Dainsleif's lieutenant; freed in spirit beneath the Chasm.

npcs.Name: The Spouses
npcs.Notes: PLACEHOLDER — the party's taken wives, Khaenri'ah royalty pursuing restoration with 'no boundaries or limits.' Names/individual profiles TBD (one per player). See question to the user.

npcs.Name: Dottore
npcs.Notes: The Doctor, 2nd of the Fatui Harbingers. Mind-controlled ~100,000 Sumeran civilians through the Akademiya's Acacia terminals, demanded the party murder Nahida to prove loyalty, and killed Kamisato Ayaka with Brian F.'s own arrow when they refused.

npcs.Name: Dehya
npcs.Notes: The party's 'Dea'. Mercenary of the Great Red Sand; fled into the desert with the party after Suristana and brokered their approach to the tribes. Guarded toward Brian C. after Brian C.'s repeated unwanted advances.

npcs.Name: Ayaka
npcs.Notes: Kamisato Ayaka, Dylan's wife and Ayato's sister. DECEASED - Dottore blinked to Ayaka and drove Brian F.'s arrow into Ayaka's chest at Suristana on Day 20. Ayaka's body was carried back to Inazuma with Dylan's letter calling the nation to war. Kept for history and as the anchor for the Inazuman fallout.
